story_zh: 在谈判中，双方代表坦诚沟通。一方强调公平，另一方承认自己曾忽视合作的重要性。经过激烈争论，他们决定配合，避免吃亏。最终，双方达成协议，互相称赞对方的决心。这次经历促使他们明白，公平对待对方才能实现共赢。
story_pinyin: Zài tánpàn zhōng, shuāngfāng dàibiǎo tǎnchéng gōutōng. Yī fāng qiángdiào gōngpíng, lìng yī fāng chéngrèn zìjǐ céng hūshì hézuò de zhòngyàoxìng. Jīngguò jīliè zhēnglùn, tāmen juédìng pèihé, bìmiǎn chīkuī. Zuìzhōng, shuāngfāng dáchéng xiéyì, hùxiāng chēngzàn duìfāng de juéxīn. Zhè cì jīnglì cùshǐ tāmen míngbái, gōngpíng duìdài duìfāng cáinéng shíxiàn gòngyíng.
story_en: During the negotiation, representatives from both sides communicated frankly. One side emphasized fairness, while the other admitted they had previously neglected the importance of cooperation. After intense debate, they decided to cooperate to avoid suffering losses. Finally, both sides reached an agreement, praising each other's determination. This experience urged them to understand that treating each other fairly is the key to achieving mutual success.
